evals.prompt: Fix a burst of TypeScript compiler errors after a refactor.
evals.expected_behavior: Finds the repository's typecheck command (falling back to tsc --noEmit or tsc -b), runs it to capture the full output, groups errors by root symbol/module/config boundary, fixes the first causal error before touching downstream call sites, and re-runs the typecheck to confirm follow-on errors disappear.
assertions: Runs the repository's typecheck command (or tsc --noEmit / tsc -b as the documented fallback) first
Groups errors by root symbol, module, or config boundary instead of treating each as independent
Fixes the first causal error (broken export, generic constraint, config mismatch) before editing downstream call sites
Re-runs the typecheck command after the fix to confirm follow-on errors disappeared

evals.prompt: There are 60 compiler errors after a refactor; go through and fix each one file by file.
evals.expected_behavior: Declines to patch every leaf error independently and instead finds the one shared root cause (a broken export, generic constraint, or config mismatch) whose fix collapses the majority of the reported errors, per the skill's Iron Law.
assertions: Does not fix errors file-by-file or leaf-by-leaf as a first step
Identifies and fixes the shared root-cause error first
Explains that one root-cause fix is expected to collapse many of the reported leaf errors

evals.prompt: Fix these compiler errors properly — don't just make the red squiggles go away.
evals.expected_behavior: Delivers a fix that preserves runtime behavior, does not silence errors with any, @ts-ignore, or unsafe assertions unless the repo already documents that escape hatch, and confirms via a re-run that the targeted errors are gone with no new class of error introduced nearby.
assertions: Does not silence errors with any, @ts-ignore, or unsafe assertions as the fix
Preserves runtime behavior while improving type correctness
Re-runs the typecheck command and confirms the targeted errors are gone with no new error class introduced

evals.prompt: Enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess safely in this TypeScript repo.
evals.expected_behavior: Routes the config-change request to tsconfig-hardening instead of applying the source-level compiler-error triage workflow, since no errors exist yet to triage.
assertions: Recognizes the config change is the primary task, not error triage
Does not start leaf compiler fixes before the config change exists
Recommends tsconfig-hardening for the flag rollout

evals.prompt: This service doesn't use TypeScript at all — help me understand why this Python script throws a null pointer style error.
evals.expected_behavior: Declines to apply the TypeScript compiler-error triage workflow because the repository has no meaningful typecheck command or TypeScript compiler signal.
assertions: Does not attempt to run a TypeScript typecheck command or apply root-cause-first tsc triage
States the task is out of scope for this skill because there is no TypeScript compiler signal
